data: What is the approximate value of the blue line in the bottom plot at the end of the graph?

The question asks for the approximate value of the blue line in the bottom plot at the end of the graph. The bottom plot shows the loss values for three models: BERT, BERT+Inter-LADA, and BERT+Semi-Inter-LADA. The blue line represents the BERT model. At the end of the graph, which corresponds to epoch 25, the blue line appears to be around 0.06. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line in the bottom plot at the end of the graph is 0.06.
